label: Russia Inflation Rate
deltaNote: Annual inflation reached 6.3% as of Sep 7, 2026, within the Bank of Russia's 6.0-7.0% full-year 2026 forecast. The central bank held its key rate at 14.00% on Sep 11, 2026 — its first pause after 8 consecutive cuts — citing rising underlying price pressure from temporary production-capacity constraints.

label: Sanctions Imposed on Russia
delta: Trump signs Graham Act into law (Sep 18, 2026); EU pledges new sanctions on Duma election organizers (Sep 21, 2026)
deltaNote: The 'Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026' passed the House 262-159 on Sep 16 and was signed into law by President Trump on Sep 18, 2026, giving the administration sweeping new authority to sanction Russia's energy/financial sectors and levy tariffs up to 100% on countries (incl. China, India) still buying large volumes of Russian oil/gas. Separately, the EU pledged new sanctions on organizers of Russia's Sep 18-20 Duma election, including candidates who stood in occupied Ukrainian territory.

label: Defense Spending (% of GDP)
deltaNote: Russia's 2025 defense budget reached ~$190B USD (7.5% of GDP), the highest since the Soviet era. Despite massive spending, GDP contracted 0.3% in Q1 2026.
